data.name: Sangeeta
data.gender_notes: Sangeeta is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'together', + gai, 'to sing' — saṅgīta, 'music'. Its root is Sanskrit saṃ + gai. A classical Sanskrit term for music. Sangeeta is a Sanskrit name meaning “Music; harmony”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sangeeta expresses “Music; harmony”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'together', + gai, 'to sing' — saṅgīta, 'music'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sangeeta total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
